messages:
tom (devex): FYI support case: new user ran `ri quickstart` after signup, saw no billing prompt, CLI logged 402 and retried for minutes. They're confused and stuck.

ales (sdk): can you paste the snippet? Is it our http client retrying?

tom (devex): user log:
```
[2026-06-04T11:03:12Z] ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
[2026-06-04T11:03:12Z] ri-cli WARN retrying (1/6) after 1000ms
[2026-06-04T11:03:13Z] ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
... repeats until exit
```
They also ran `ri account status` and saw `billing_state: pending`, no workspace.

min (eng): This is a DX problem. 402 is not transient; CLI should not retry. Looks like recent retry middleware treats any non-network error as retryable.

ales (sdk): Agreed. Node + Go got the new middleware; Python never retried 401/402. I'll push a small fix to blacklist 401/402 and make the CLI print a clear action.

tom (devex): Suggested UX text: "Account blocked: complete billing to create a workspace. Run `ri billing add-card` or visit https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing. Org: <org-id>." Also prefer immediate exit with non-zero code so CI/users don't wait.

ales (sdk): Opening cross-repo issue RD-4291 and PRs: node-sdk#811, go-sdk#402. Adding integration test that simulates 402 and asserts no retries and helpful message.

bot-deploy: Deployed ri-cli v0.10.2-beta to staging with 402 handling change. Running quickstart smoke. :white_check_mark:

min (eng): I'll backport to dedicated branch. tom, can you update KB with exact troubleshooting steps and the `ri account status` fields to look for?

tom (devex): On it. For the support case I told the user to run `ri account status`, share org id and billing_state; if pending/blocked follow billing link or escalate. Closing the loop once KB published. :memo:
